intro100: Find the sale, choose the outcome and prepare a request for review.
lookupHelp100: Choose a sale from the list or use the receipt reference.
refundHelp100: Request a refund to the customer.
exchangeHelp100: Request an exchange; the replacement item will be defined during review.
creditHelp100: Request credit, subject to the store policy and approval.
remainingHelp100: This limit only includes active requests saved in this local workspace. The responsible service must validate the complete history.
cancelHelp100: Full cancellation cannot be combined with active local returns for the same sale.
confirm100: Record this local request? The sale and payments will not be changed yet.
changed100: The sale data changed. Review the new result before continuing.
invalidReply100: The sale data could not be validated. Look it up again.
sourceError100: Could not retrieve the sale. Check the reference and try again.
noValue100: This quantity gives an estimated amount of zero. Review the quantity.
quantityError100: Check the quantity and available limit. Items sold by unit require whole numbers.
queueHelp100: Accepting a local review does not execute refunds, exchanges, credit, fiscal cancellation or a return to inventory.
withdrawConfirm100: Withdraw this local request? History will be preserved.
reviewConfirm100: Confirm this local decision with the stated reason?
aboutHelp100: Records stay on this computer. The responsible service must authorize and execute payment, inventory and fiscal actions. This screen does not define return rights or policies.
unknownUnit100: The original unit is missing from the receipt. Check the quantity with the responsible person.
dateMissing100: Sale date unavailable in this query
receiptCancelled100: This sale is already cancelled. Another request cannot be created.
blocked100: A cancellation request exists or no quantity is available in this local record.
declared100: Payment methods recorded in the sale
notFiscal100: LOCAL REQUEST. Not a refund confirmation or fiscal document.
invalid100: Check the fields and try again.
readOnly100: Viewing another operator: create new requests in your own workspace.
searchSale100: Find sale by date or reference
